messages:
olivia (AE): Quick heads-up 12: BlueBridge security asked for access-control evidence for their vendor review: SAML/SP metadata, MFA policy (console/CLI/API), RBAC role matrix, and a signed "least privilege" attestation. They want artifacts before the POC on Thu. Can we package this by Wed EOD?

diego (SE): Yes. I can export SP metadata and add an example SAML Response. Do we have a public SP metadata URL we can hand them?

han (Security): Our SP metadata is at https://console.redwood.ai/saml/metadata (valid XML). We can also provide a signed PDF export if they require an auditable copy. MFA: we don't force MFA on API keys server-side; we rely on IdP-enforced MFA for interactive console/SSO logins. For programmatic access we recommend: scoped API keys with expiry or short-lived tokens from federated sessions (OIDC).

nora (PS): BlueBridge specifically asked about CLI/SDK flows. Answer: interactive CLI auth uses browser SSO (so MFA enforced at IdP). For non-interactive automation use ephemeral tokens or service accounts scoped to minimum permissions. I'll draft a one-page guidance doc.

diego (SE): I'll include a sample API call to create a scoped key and a sample JSON policy for a "project-analytics-readonly" role.

diego (SE): snippet:
```
POST /v1/orgs/{org_id}/api-keys
{
  "name": "bluebridge-poc-readonly",
  "scopes": ["models.view","jobs.list","embeddings.read"],
  "expires_in": "48h"
}
```

han (Security): RBAC defaults: owner, security-auditor, infra-admin, project-admin, developer, viewer. I'll export roles_permissions.csv and a short excerpt from Access Control Policy. Also preparing an attestation: "Redwood Inference provisions new organizations with least-privilege default roles; elevated privileges must be explicitly granted. Customers may require SSO (SAML/OIDC) and enforce MFA at their identity provider. Programmatic access is provided via scoped, expirational credentials; service tokens do not grant console admin privileges by default."

nora (PS): I'll add a quick how-to: enable SSO, toggle "Require IdP MFA" in Console, create scoped API keys, review role assignments. That should help them finish the questionnaire.

diego (SE): Also adding a troubleshooting note: if a customer wants CLI MFA for automation, recommend short-lived federated tokens + periodic rotation via CI.

share-bot: Files uploaded to share: https://files.redwood.ai/share/bluebridge-iam-package (id: d4c9f1) :file_folder: (sp-metadata.xml, roles_permissions.csv, console-mfa-screenshot.png, attestation-signed.pdf, poc-scope-snippet.md)

han (Security): Attestation draft below for quick review before signing:
"Redwood Inference implements role-based access control and provisions least-privilege default roles for new organizations. Customers can enforce SSO via SAML 2.0 or OIDC and configure MFA at their identity provider. Programmatic access is supported using scoped API keys and short-lived federated tokens; elevated privileges require explicit assignment. Service tokens are isolated and do not provide management-plane admin access unless explicitly granted"

diego (SE): LGTM. Minor suggestion: add sentence about audit logging of role changes.

han (Security): Good call. Added: "All role modifications are logged and retained per our retention policy; audit exports can be provided under NDA."

olivia (AE): Amazing. Timeline check: artifacts + signed attestation by Wed 17:00 PT. I'll put links into BlueBridge's questionnaire and schedule the POC Thu 9am. If they request SOC2 workpapers, route to Legal for redaction. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
